review_method: Direct inspection of actual SIDE, FRONT34, REAR34 and BACK Cycles renders and reference/R4/trial pixel comparison boards.

A.reason: Common layer direction collapsed into a single blade in SIDE. Inlay faces bridged underlying facets and became visually fragmented. The exposed central rod was reduced but the canonical layered silhouette was lost.

B.reason: Alternating upper and lower layer exits restore the layered silhouette; conforming inlays remove the fragmented color panels. Independent reload found four distal root centers outside the core, so this checkpoint was not selected.

C.reason: Same improved layered silhouette with the distal two root pairs repositioned into the continuous tail. All 14 root centers are inside by the nearest-normal diagnostic. Four actual rendered views inspected.

SIDE.improvement: Long upper layers and deeper lower exits replace the identical repeated thin slats. The long round central highlight is mostly covered and the terminal silhouette retains its downward reach.
SIDE.remaining: The proximal root has a rounded cap; layer grouping is still simpler and straighter than the concept, with less sculpted faceting.

FRONT34.improvement: The layers form a connected rearward flow rather than separate chips alongside a rod.
FRONT34.remaining: Layer tips are still too linear and the side envelope is narrower than the concept in this projection; the concept camera and pose are not identical.

REAR34.improvement: Broad lenticular volumes and embedded origins obscure the central tube; blue and ivory areas follow the actual surface.
REAR34.remaining: Paired contours remain too regular, with bright smooth surfaces rather than the concept's dark, sharply divided planes.

BACK.improvement: The exposed central stalk and its separate needle tip are reduced; overlapping tapered layers form a continuous tail mass.
BACK.remaining: Bilateral chevrons are still repetitive and the central white/blue pattern differs from the concept.

root_connection: Volumetric embedding of closed detail meshes; not a welded, rig-ready topology.
next_revision: Refine the rounded root transition, irregular interlocking layer contours and dark/blue plane distribution without changing S identity; then resolve welded topology and validate gait/runtime before any production promotion.
